headline: This area covers sending notifications and accepting remote commands through team chat tools (Microsoft Teams and Slack), and the code we examined did not confirm either piece of work.
what_is_there: The code we saw does include a background task scheduler that pops up a desktop/tray notification when a task finishes, plus admin email alerts elsewhere. What we could not find was anything for posting notifications into a team's chat channels, any configurable schedule for those notification checks, or any way to control the product remotely from a chat tool.
what_is_unclear: Neither ticket could be settled: the Teams notification settings did not appear in the files reviewed, and for the Slack remote integration no relevant code was retrieved at all and the ticket itself is barely more than a title. Because the review only looked at a keyword-selected slice of the repository, this is not evidence the work is absent.
suggested_action: Ask the developer on these two tickets to point to where the Teams notification settings and Slack remote integration live, and get the Slack ticket written up with actual requirements beyond its title.
caveat: Some of the architecture documentation pulled in during the review appeared to describe a different system, so background material for this area should be treated with care.
